hero.subject: An example of Bernhard Heine's manually cranked chain osteotome, not Aitken's original 1785 saw
hero.creator: Sabine Salfer
hero.permission_evidence: Commons file information: author released photograph into public domain worldwide; permission correspondence ticket #2007070510005121
hero.caption: A surviving hand-cranked chain osteotome associated with Bernhard Heine's 19th-century surgical invention, photographed at Orthopädische Universitätsklinik Frankfurt. Not Aitken's 1785 obstetric saw.
hero.alt: Historical hand-cranked surgical osteotome with wooden handle, metal mechanisms and linked cutting chain, on a blue background
